mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t2.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t2.CJ_NM AS cj_nm , CASE WHEN t2.AS_CJ_CD IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS siga_yn FROM SCM0CM t1 JOIN SCM0CJ t2 ON t2.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND t2.JM_CD = t1.JM_CD WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NVL(t1.BFIL_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t1.MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t1.MEDO_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t1.MSD_MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t1.MSD_MEDO_AEKM, 0) != 0 ORDER BY t2.JM_CD ASC

SELECT t1.JM_CD AS jm_cd , t1.CJ_FNM AS cj_fnm , t1.CJ_NM AS cj_nm , t1.CJ_ENM AS cj_enm , TO_CHAR(t1.BALH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS balh_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghw_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.MEDO_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS medo_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.SUNME_IJA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sunme_ija_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.BF_IJA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS bf_ija_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.AF_IJA_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS af_ija_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.BUDO_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS budo_ymd , TO_CHAR(t1.JM_CRE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS jm_cre_dt , t1.SANGJ_GB AS sangj_gb , t1.SUNHU_GB AS sunhu_gb , t1.HALIN_GB AS halin_gb , t1.BUNHAL_GB AS bunhal_gb , t1.YDONG_GB AS ydong_gb , t1.BOND_ATTR AS bond_attr , t1.IJA_JIGUB_GB AS ija_jigub_gb , t1.BOND_CD AS bond_cd , t1.BALH_GA AS balh_ga , t1.BALH_CO AS balh_co , t1.BOJNG_CO AS bojng_co , t1.BALH_AEK AS balh_aek , t1.IJA_YY_SU AS ija_yy_su , t1.YY_IJA_HOISU AS yy_ija_hoisu , t1.TOT_IJA_HOICHA AS tot_ija_hoicha , t1.NOW_GUGAN_NO AS now_gugan_no , t1.PYOM_IYUL AS pyom_iyul , t1.HALIN_IYUL AS halin_iyul , t1.HALJ_IYUL AS halj_iyul , t5.CHG_JM_CD AS chg_jm_cd , t5.CHG_GA AS chg_ga , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t5.CHG_START_IL, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS chg_start , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t5.CHG_END_IL, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS chg_end , NVL(t1.AS_CJ_CD, t1.JM_CD) AS as_cj_cd , CASE WHEN t1.AS_CJ_CD IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS siga_gb , t5.HUSUNWI_GB AS husunwi_gb , sm.KIS_PG_NM AS kis_grade , sm.KIS_SUIK_RT AS kis_suik_rt , sm.KIS_DANGA AS kis_danga , sm.KAP_PG_NM AS kap_grade , sm.KAP_SUIK_RT AS kap_suik_rt , sm.KAP_DANGA AS kap_danga , sm.NICE_PG_NM AS nice_grade , sm.NICE_SUIK_RT AS nice_suik_rt , sm.NICE_DANGA AS nice_danga , sm.JY_SUIK_RT AS jy_suik_rt , sm.DANGA AS jy_danga FROM SCM0CJ t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM0CJ_KAP t5 ON t5.AS_CJ_CD = NVL(t1.AS_CJ_CD, t1.JM_CD) LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM1SM sm ON sm.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND sm.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND sm.AS_CJ_CD = NVL(t1.AS_CJ_CD, t1.JM_CD) WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd}

SELECT t2.JM_CD AS jm_cd , TO_CHAR(t2.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t2.FUND_CD AS fund_cd , ia.FUND_NM AS fund_nm , ia.FUND_NM AS xx_fund_cd , NVL(t2.BFIL_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t2.MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t2.MEDO_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t2.MSD_MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t2.MSD_MEDO_AEKM, 0) AS aekm , NVL(t2.BFIL_CHUI_AEK, 0) + NVL(t2.MEIB_AEK, 0) - NVL(t2.MEDO_AEK, 0) + NVL(t2.ANBUN_AEK, 0) + NVL(t2.MSD_MEIB_AEK, 0) - NVL(t2.MSD_MEDO_AEK, 0) AS chui_aek , t2.SUNG_COST AS sung_cost , NVL(t2.PR_SUNG_COST, 0) + NVL(sc.SUNG_COST, 0) AS pr_sung_cost , sc.SUNG_COST AS sc_sung_cost , t2.MISU_IJA AS misu_ija , NVL(t2.PR_MISU_IJA, 0) + NVL(sc.MISU_IJA, 0) AS pr_misu_ija , sc.MISU_IJA AS sc_misu_ija , t2.DAY_IJA AS day_misu_ija , NVL(t2.PR_DAY_IJA, 0) AS day_pr_ija , sc.DAY_IJA AS sc_day_ija , NVL(ig.GUGAN_MISU_IJA, 0) AS gugan_misu_ija , NVL(ig.GUGAN_PR_IJA, 0) + NVL(sc.GUGAN_IJA, 0) AS gugan_pr_ija , sc.GUGAN_IJA AS sc_gugan_ija , TRUNC(t2.SUNG_TAX) AS sung_tax , TRUNC(NVL(t2.PR_SUNG_TAX, 0)) + TRUNC(NVL(sc.SUNG_TAX, 0)) AS pr_sung_tax , TRUNC(sc.SUNG_TAX) AS sc_sung_tax , 0 AS sunn_tax , 0 AS pr_sunn_tax , t2.DAY_ANBUN_AEK AS day_anbun_aek , 0 AS gugan_anbun_aek , t2.ANBUN_AEK AS anbun_aek , '(' || REPLACE(mm.TR_CO_NM, '은행', '') || ')' AS sutak_nm FROM SCM0CM t2 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t2.CORP_GR AND ia.FUND_CD = t2.FUND_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN SZX2MM mm ON mm.CORP_GR = ia.CORP_GR AND mm.TR_CO_CD = ia.MG_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM0SC sc ON sc.CORP_GR = t2.CORP_GR AND sc.FUND_CD = t2.FUND_CD AND sc.YMD = t2.YMD AND sc.JM_CD = t2.JM_CD AND sc.BUY_DATE = t2.BUY_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT CORP_GR, JM_CD , MAX(CASE WHEN IJA_GB = 'B' THEN GUGAN_IJA ELSE 0 END) AS GUGAN_MISU_IJA , MAX(CASE WHEN IJA_GB IN ('I','J') THEN GUGAN_IJA ELSE 0 END) AS GUGAN_PR_IJA FROM SCJ0IG GROUP BY CORP_GR, JM_CD ) ig ON ig.CORP_GR = t2.CORP_GR AND ig.JM_CD = t2.JM_CD WHERE t2.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t2.YMD = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t2.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND NVL(t2.BFIL_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t2.MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t2.MEDO_AEKM, 0) + NVL(t2.MSD_MEIB_AEKM, 0) - NVL(t2.MSD_MEDO_AEKM, 0) != 0 ORDER BY t2.FUND_CD ASC
